mode: manual source tracing with partial Graphify discovery

traversal.filters: Director task approval/dispatch, saved goal continuation/recovery, typed MCP and shared chat; generic Graphify uses edges excluded unless source confirmed

limitations: Full AST refresh scans 657 code files, no clustering or complete test edges. Tool reports 102 zero-node and 50 unclassified files. Incremental replacement dropped unchanged nodes, so --force was required. Cross-community means another source module.
Test-gap=0 means focused static test-reference evidence, not full coverage. Max risk is prioritization, not a defect probability.
Actual browser authority gate failed; H3 is incomplete. H4–H6, previous Kdenlive enclosing-sandbox errors and seven broader UI failures are untouched.
